FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 246
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/02/2025
Senate Bill 246 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Department
of Human Resources by a department estimated $14 million for the anticipated increase in
determining eligibility for SNAP benefits. In addition, this bill could decrease enrollment in
SNAP by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of households receiving SNAP
benefits based upon categorical eligibility that may no longer qualify for the SNAP benefits.
